about.title: Who is Phixalek?
about.lead: Alejandro Segura was born in Colombia and is currently pursuing a Multimedia Engineering degree. He moves between [[software development]] and personal projects mixing technology with storytelling.
about.body:
He is developing **Flowly**, a personal finance project starting with ((.NET 10)); and **Bloomink**, his indie studio where he is building *No Witness*, a survival narrative inspired by Resident Evil and Silent Hill using ((UE5 + C++)).

Now based in Hermosillo, Mexico, he is studying Multimedia Engineering and teaching programming.
